uiActions.name: create_subscription
uiActions.description: Notify a target when GitHub events match: repositories, an organization or all, event names, filters, and a target (the person, an agent, a Room's agent or a workflow). The kernel delivers the events; nothing polls. An agent subscribes itself with this; for any other target use create_subscription_for_others. A one-shot (once) ends after its first delivery or at its expiry, which also notifies once. "ci.finished" fires when every check of the pull request's head commit completed.
